_comment: The Instagram token's issue date. debug_token does not answer for Instagram Login tokens, so remaining life is calculated from this rather than asked for. refresh-token.mjs updates it after a successful refresh.
note: Generated from the Meta app page, API setup with Instagram login, Generate token.
refreshNote: Refresh endpoint tested against the live API. Returns a new 60-day token; the previous token remains valid, so refreshing is non-destructive.
